qa story.purpose: Read the selected Story or prepare a Story creation preview.

qa requirements.purpose: Translate verified Story evidence into testable requirements.

qa test-design.purpose: Turn accepted requirements into test cases and traceability.

qa test-review.purpose: Review the test design before implementation.

qa implement.purpose: Implement the approved feature and associated non-browser tests.

qa e2e.purpose: Implement the approved Playwright browser cases.

qa run.purpose: Run the approved tests and report verified results.

qa xray.purpose: Prepare and verify publication of reviewed Xray Tests.

qa test-plan.purpose: Prepare the required Xray Test Plan and Story link.

qa xray-results.purpose: Prepare the verified results for an approved Xray import.

qa xray-status.purpose: Review optional Xray issue status work and prepare one eligible Jira transition.

qa pr.purpose: Prepare verified changes for GitHub delivery.

qa close.purpose: Verify closeout evidence and prepare the Story status transition.

qa status.purpose: Report current Story and approval status.

qa summary.purpose: Summarize recorded QA evidence and progress.

qa next.purpose: Resolve and perform one permitted QA stage.

approvalGates.qa story: Jira creation needs its own approval; existing Story intake is read-only.
approvalGates.qa implement: Approve application edits separately from any Jira transition.
approvalGates.qa e2e: Confirm test-file scope; browser execution needs separate approval.
approvalGates.qa xray: Approve exact Xray publication and links.
approvalGates.qa test-plan: Approve exact Test Plan creation or link.
approvalGates.qa xray-status: Approve each exact Jira status transition.
approvalGates.qa pr: Stage, commit, push and PR creation have separate gates; merge is manual.
